{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Reconstruct masked cells from the horizontal cyclic pattern, using observed cells
    # to select the dominant phase in each row.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        phases=[(v-1-c)%9 for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if not phases: continue
        phase=max(set(phases),key=phases.count)
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0: out[r][c]=(phase+c)%9+1
    return out
"
